resources.string: Works in the Outlook app\'s calendar when you tap a button in Calendar Autopilot: it reads the labels (categories) of events, to set alarms for those labelled Moveable or Immoveable, and it creates, changes or deletes the room-booking events you ask for (Room Booking - …), using Outlook\'s Room Finder. It only works inside Outlook, never opens emails, and nothing leaves the phone except what Outlook itself sends for a booking you confirmed.
